cohort: The study included a convenience sample of 64 pregnant women attending the obstetrical outpatient clinic at Suez Canal University Hospital.
finding: The study found that prenatal physical activity significantly reduced the incidence of Caesarean sections, increased the incidence of intact perineum, and was associated with other benefits like reduced excessive prenatal weight gain, lower gestational diabetes mellitus, and preeclampsia.
mod_finding: Caesarean section incidence was significantly lower in the prenatal physical activity group (12.5%) compared to the control group (37.5%).
